literal_copy_to_render.copy_policy: Render only this supplied communication copy; do not invent filler, ownership marks, addresses, awards, QR codes or extra English.

aspect_intent.adaptation: Compose natively for the frame; do not reproduce or imitate any existing 灶边味 poster layout.

photographic_subject_direction: A real layered mountain-kitchen dining environment, not a scenic forest wallpaper: credible architecture, cooking/dining materials and lived-in spatial cues with foreground/midground/background separation, natural occlusion, selective depth and quiet tonal pockets for information.

required_invariants_hypotheses.instruction: Make the exact title 灶边味 the first read as one newly authored, legible display mass; use unequal optical mass and restrained counter/surface variation without becoming pseudo-Chinese or a stock-font line.
Maintain a dominant title, a clearly quieter support tier and a sparse tertiary closure; scale and contrast gaps must remain visible at thumbnail and normal view.
Place small copy only in locally quiet, contrast-safe photographic pockets; let the larger title cross richer detail only when its area and contrast remain sufficient.
Build truthful near/mid/far spatial depth or an equivalent coherent depth structure around the information plane.
Counterbalance the authored title mass against an active photographic world; neither layer may become weak or erase the other.
Protect continuous real material texture, natural edges, plausible light and selective focus from global poster effects.

permitted_freedoms.instruction: Use a truthful mountain-kitchen interior/environment instead of foliage while preserving the environmental-field role.
Author new contours for 灶边味; character identity and exact readability are fixed.
Choose a new crop and mass arrangement that creates depth and usable information pockets.
Place the title in the strongest local contrast-safe region and balance it optically, not mechanically.
A sparse subject-relevant accent may change hue or be omitted.
Arrange only the supplied support copy; reduce optional peripheral treatment rather than inventing filler.

color_role_controls: The photographic environment owns most chromatic area.
The main title owns the highest information contrast.
Support copy remains visibly quieter than the title.
Any accent is scarce, semantically assigned and may use a new hue or be omitted.
Do not prescribe green forest, a white-title recipe or an orange line.
typography_controls: Render 灶边味 exactly and legibly.
Treat the title as one broad authored display object with unequal optical mass and controlled counter shapes.
Use restrained surface irregularity only when character identity remains unmistakable.
Keep WOK HEI, MOUNTAIN KITCHEN and 山野风味 · 现炒现做 clean, truthful and subordinate.
Avoid generic stock-font poster hierarchy, fake calligraphy and unreadable pseudo-Chinese.
brand_bound_exclusions: Do not reuse or imitate exact 山野集 glyph contours, missing-stroke locations or word silhouette.
Do not use 李家班 identity, WANCE / 万策 identity, source logos, wordmarks or proprietary footer lockups.
Do not reuse exact source mountain, badge, path, seal or scribble tokens.
Do not copy the source forest crop, source palette coordinates or source layout coordinates.
Do not use or imitate the current ad-hoc 灶边味 poster or its composition.
failure_boundaries: Reject if the title is a stock-font line, unreadable, text-only in mass or visually copied from a source-brand wordmark.
Reject if the mountain-kitchen environment becomes generic scenic wallpaper, a flat texture or a forest token substitution.
Reject if title, support copy and photograph become isolated rectangular layers with blanket gradient panels or heavy fake shadows.
Reject if all regions carry equal information density or if invented microcopy competes with the title.
Reject if arbitrary stickers, badges, mountains, scribbles or accent paths are added without subject-derived semantic work.
Reject if global grunge, plastic texture, synthetic glow, oversharpening or mechanical centering destroys realism and optical balance.
realism_constraints: Use credible commercial photography with real material response, natural imperfection, coherent contact/occlusion and plausible light.
Keep near/mid/far separation natural; do not use a pasted blur mask.
Avoid repeated AI microtexture, synthetic bloom, HDR halos, glossy CGI surfaces and a global cinematic color cast.
Graphic treatment must remain local and clean enough that the photograph still reads continuously.
renderer_instruction: Generate exactly one new 3:4 portrait brand-editorial image for a mountain-kitchen restaurant. Use no reference images. Let the photographic field own chromatic area, the title own maximum information contrast and any accent remain scarce, subject-relevant and optional.
